title: Axolotl with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#ffd1e3'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- Head lighter top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#ffb8d5'/>
  <!-- Left gill branches -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#ff6fa3' transform='rotate(-30 26 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='44' rx='3' ry='9' fill='#ff5c95' transform='rotate(-10 22 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='52' rx='3' ry='8' fill='#ff6fa3' transform='rotate(15 24 52)'/>
  <!-- Right gill branches -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='36' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#ff6fa3' transform='rotate(30 74 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='3' ry='9' fill='#ff5c95' transform='rotate(10 78 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='52' rx='3' ry='8' fill='#ff6fa3' transform='rotate(-15 76 52)'/>
  <!-- Eyes whites -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a2e'/>
  <!-- Sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='45.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='48.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffeef6'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='45.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffeef6'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='3' fill='#ff6fa3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3' fill='#ff6fa3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 56 Q50 60 55 56' stroke='#c94a7a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffb8d5' transform='rotate(-20 28 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffb8d5' transform='rotate(20 72 72)'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffb8d5'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffb8d5'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M74 72 Q86 70 88 78 Q82 80 74 76' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- Extra sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
